title: Honest Null Precision for Counterfactual Untreated-Risk Calibration under Rough Selection
banked_reason: Stage 0.5 (typed) BELOW NOVELTY FLOOR (triage, round 0) — D0.5.G tier=incremental < floor=field (target=field) and NOT salvageable in scope.
gap_reasons: The delivered statements support the matched n^{-8/25} order on the specified parent; the headline does not leave its converse or whole-null coverage deferred. The contribution nevertheless evaluates only one fixed smoothness configuration and supplies no characterization of when causal nuisance estimation changes the calibration precision order. Higher-order projection corrections already form part of the established substrate in [Robins et al.](https://arxiv.org/html/1512.02174v3), while this package establishes a specialized projected-null combination rather than a broader inference framework. The attaining interval deterministically reports the entire parameter range for every n<2^{512}, so finite computability provides no usable prospective audit at realistic sample sizes. The standard model restrictions are legitimate scope, but the isolated benchmark and absence of informative finite-sample supporting evidence constrain significance and the projected paper score. Those substantive limits warrant subfield rather than field, independently of the note's own tier disclaimers. [D0.5.G projected paper-score gate: paper_score_ceiling 5.8 < 7.4, so the graded tier 'subfield' is capped at 'incremental'. The score assesses the delivered research package without credit for unfinished work.]
proof_attempt_summary: Discovery derived matching n^(-8/25) upper and lower bounds on the fixed beta=1/10 projected-calibration benchmark, with an explicit finite-honest construction and exact-null original-record mixtures. The field-tier promise failed on scope and practical precision: the attaining construction returns the full range below n=2^512, and no smoothness/design regime characterization was delivered. MAIN independently reproduced cancellation of the disputed cubic likelihood term and confirmed downgraded disposition; Lean formalization did not run, and a beta-indexed extension remains a new research project.
tldr: For the fixed public-design benchmark, the whole-parent finite-honesty null precision is \(L_{0,n}\asymp n^{-8/25}\) with no essential logarithmic factor. One total original-record interval attains the upper bound using cubic observable ratio corrections and independent coefficient cross products; paired fine-cell and coarse-score mixtures give the matching all-procedure lower bound. The result concerns squared untreated-risk calibration for a fixed score under fixed regularity and does not validate the consumer software's absolute ICI or LOESS bootstrap.
gap: Direct-label calibration testing and confidence intervals do not account for unknown rough treatment selection. Orthogonal causal calibration bounds do not evaluate \(L_{0,n}\). Existing scalar missing-response and composite quadratic theory must be checked at the projected-null likelihood boundary.
fill: The required advance is a numerically evaluated precision order, including essential logarithms, attained by a single finitely computable original-record rule and matched by null-supported mixtures on this exact parent. Boyer et al. motivate untreated ASCVD risk assessment; the proposed squared audit is prospective and does not certify the software's absolute ICI or LOESS bootstrap.
